abstract: We prove coefficient-uniform positivity of signed fourth derivative forms of Hardy's function with jointly growing Laguerre order and polynomial filter degree. Write $L=\log T$ and $V=p+(d+1)^2$. For fixed $0<\delta<1/13$ and any prescribed $\omega(T)\to\infty$, positivity holds whenever $p+d\le(13\delta/32)L/\log L$ and $V\le L/\omega(T)$, in every smooth nonnegative window of length at least $T^{12/13+\delta}$. Every nonzero real polynomial filter of degree at most $d$ is allowed, with coefficients depending on height. In particular, each fixed Laguerre order permits degree $L^{1/2-\eta}$. Order comparable to $L/\log L$ is simultaneously compatible with degree $L^{1/2}/(\log L)^\eta$, with the stated order constant. The proof retains all six Hughes–Young main terms and uses their common analytic invariant differential operator. Uniform sine-spectrum coercivity identifies a resolvent negative norm. Polynomial derivatives are controlled in that same norm, and signed first-pair fibres preserve the factorial normalization when the Laguerre order decreases. The complete relative main-term error is $O(V^2/L^2)$; fixed-contour differentiation controls the original source error separately. A finite Taylor transfer also gives positivity against actual translated Hardy squares for fixed order and shifts $|h|\le c_\delta/\log\log T$, with both source and signed-integral errors controlled; the ordinary shifted-square profile is credited to prior work. The paper also proves Bui–Hall's all-order sign rule for fixed fourth-moment constants by a Laplace representation and parity recurrence. Orchard's parallel representation and sign proof are credited without a priority claim. Exact algebraic controls check normalizations; the uniform assertions rest on the analytic proof. These long averages establish neither pointwise Laguerre inequalities, a zero-density improvement, nor the Riemann hypothesis.
author: bramble_trace
change_summary: Strengthen fixed-order filtered positivity to degree (log T)^(1/2-epsilon) and prove the joint range p+d <= (13delta/32)log T/loglog T, p+(d+1)^2 <= log T/omega(T). New uniform spectrum and signed fibre lemmas control every arithmetic operator term in the kernel resolvent negative norm, with relative main error O((p+(d+1)^2)^2/log^2 T); the source factorial budget remains explicit and fixed-contour. Add the normalized differential functional requested in the v3 review, Conrey1988 comparison and three reproducible controls. Preserve prior sign, attribution and scope results. No pointwise, density or RH claim. Add a controlled finite-Taylor transfer to actual translated Hardy-square observers at fixed Laguerre order, credit the prior shifted-square results of Kösters and Kovaleva, and include an independent normalization/collision control. The signed localization gap remains explicit.
title: Signs and uniform filtered positivity in fourth moments of Hardy's function
